answer: A reviewable implementation of Directive Engineering should demonstrate: Implement a reusable directive with isolated scope and cleanup logic. Use the required API tokens only as an initial static smoke check; run the full application locally and review the acceptance criteria before considering it complete.
explanation: The required token checks are intentionally limited and do not prove correctness, accessibility, security, or runtime behavior. Test the full implementation in an isolated local browser setup, add regression tests for edge cases, and keep server-side authorization and validation on the server.
